title: Nurturing Polish Tuna Fried-Rice
description: A herbal, silky dish that blends tender tuna with fragrant dill and a splash of sesame, perfect for a cozy date night.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until translucent, about 2 minutes.
Add the carrot and peas, cooking until the carrot is slightly tender, about 3 minutes.
Push the vegetables to the side of the skillet and pour in the cooked rice, stirring to combine.
Pour the soy sauce and sesame oil over the rice, mixing thoroughly until the rice is evenly coated.
Gently fold in the flaked tuna, ensuring it is heated through but not overcooked.
Sprinkle the chopped dill over the mixture and stir to distribute the herbal aroma.
Serve immediately, optionally garnishing with a few extra dill sprigs.
